facts.fact: TerraMar Networks Ltd describes its tracpoint software as a secure web-based solution providing individual users with their own secure login, which can also integrate a single sign-on (SSO) secure authentication procedure redirected to the customer organization's sign-in page.
facts.source: TerraMar Networks (Frequently Asked Questions; Login with SSO)

facts.fact: The company's general website privacy policy notes that collected data may be processed and stored inside or outside the European Union (EU), and that data transmissions over the internet remain at the user's risk.

For its mobile versions, the Tracpoint app developer declarations on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store indicate that 'No data is collected' from the application and 'No data is shared with third parties'.
facts.source: Apple App Store / Google Play Store (Tracpoint App Privacy Declarations)
